prompts.prompt: A realistic farmer walking through a green field at sunrise. Wide shot, gentle tracking camera, warm morning light.
A cinematic car driving through a rainy city at night. The camera tracks beside the car; wet neon reflections move across the street.
A dog running along a beach while the camera follows it smoothly from a low angle in daylight.
A woman speaking to the camera inside a modern office. Medium shot, natural hand gestures, stable eye contact, soft window lighting.
A bird flying over a mountain landscape. Aerial wide shot with slow forward camera movement and crisp daylight.
A cartoon character running through a futuristic city. Side tracking shot, energetic motion, colorful glowing signs.

rating_rubric.prompt_adherence: 1–5: requested subject, action, environment, camera, lighting and style are present.
rating_rubric.motion_quality: 1–5: movement is natural and matches the requested action/camera motion.
rating_rubric.temporal_consistency: 1–5: identity, objects and geometry remain stable with minimal flicker.
rating_rubric.visual_quality: 1–5: detail, artifacts, exposure and compression quality.
rating_rubric.style_adherence: 1–5: requested style is visible without contradicting the prompt.
rating_rubric.aspect_ratio_correctness: pass/fail: generated dimensions match the requested orientation.
